The resources recorded for Patient 02.

Base.Management

The episode of care the plan is delivered under, and that every record of care refers back to.

EpisodeOfCares

The episode everything patient-specific hangs off: the plan is delivered under it, and every measurement and response refers back to it.

Name Description
Episode of care 1 (completed) A completed episode of care, addressing the COPD diagnosis.
Episode of care 2 (active) An open episode of care, addressing the COPD diagnosis.

Clinical.Care Provision

The plan as delivered to the patient: the care plan, the service requests it consists of, and the care team responsible.

CarePlans

The plan definition as delivered to the patient, one per episode. Normally created by $apply, which would also create one ServiceRequest per activity.

Name Description
Care plan 1 (completed) The monitoring plan as delivered under episode of care 1.
Care plan 2 (active) The monitoring plan as delivered under episode of care 2.

ServiceRequests

One per activity of a care plan, created by $apply alongside it. A measurement or questionnaire response is submitted against one of these, and the measurement ones carry the reference ranges triage compares a value against.

Name Description
Closing (scheduled) — completed Guidance screen shown after the scheduled round is complete.
Head activity (extra) — completed The container for the unscheduled branch.
Pulse (extra) — completed The unscheduled pulse measurement, with the same four absolute reference ranges as the scheduled one.
Questionnaire (extra) — completed The unscheduled symptom questionnaire. This is the request a test questionnaire response is most easily submitted against, since it is not bound to a window.
Saturation and pulse device group (extra) — completed Groups the unscheduled saturation and pulse measurements as one device group.
Oxygen saturation (extra) — completed The unscheduled oxygen saturation measurement, with the same absolute reference ranges as the scheduled one. A submission against this request can be made at any time.
Head activity (scheduled) — completed The container for the scheduled branch. Nothing is submitted against it; it groups the activities below.
Introduction (scheduled) — completed Guidance screen shown at the start of the scheduled measurement round.
Pulse (scheduled) — completed The scheduled pulse measurement. Carries four absolute reference ranges, so both a low and a high value triage red: red at or below 50/min and at or above 130/min, yellow in between.
Questionnaire (scheduled) — completed The scheduled symptom questionnaire. A questionnaire response is submitted against this request and triaged on its answer significance.
Saturation and pulse device group (scheduled) — completed Groups the saturation and pulse measurements as one device group, so both are taken from the same device in one go.
Saturation and pulse introduction (scheduled) — completed Guidance screen introducing the saturation and pulse measurements.
Saturation and pulse preparation (scheduled) — completed Guidance screen telling the patient how to prepare before measuring.
Oxygen saturation (scheduled) — completed The scheduled oxygen saturation measurement. Carries the absolute reference ranges its triage rule compares a submitted value against: red at or below 85%, yellow from 85% to 88%.

Clinical.Diagnostics

What the patient submitted: the measurements and the questionnaire responses.

Observations

The measurements submitted, two per submission. Their values are chosen to produce a known triage colour against the reference ranges they carry.

Name Description
Pulse 72/min (completed episode) Pulse submitted against the unscheduled branch of the completed episode's care plan. 72/min falls between the low and high ranges, so triage returns green and the resulting task is routine.
Oxygen saturation 96% (completed episode) Oxygen saturation submitted against the unscheduled branch of the completed episode's care plan. 96% is above every absolute range, so triage returns green and the resulting task is routine.
Pulse 118/min (open episode) Pulse submitted under the open episode. 118/min falls in the upper yellow range of 110 to 130, so triage returns yellow and raises a task with priority urgent.
Oxygen saturation 84% (open episode) Oxygen saturation submitted under the open episode. 84% is at or below the red absolute range of 85%, so triage returns red and raises a task with priority asap.

QuestionnaireResponses

The questionnaire answered as part of each submission. The answers are chosen to produce a known triage colour through the answer significance the questionnaire defines.

Name Description
Questionnaire response, mild symptoms (completed episode) A symptom questionnaire answered under the completed episode. 4 scored answers — 1 yellow, 3 green — so triage returns yellow and the resulting task is urgent.
Questionnaire response, exacerbation (open episode) A symptom questionnaire answered under the open episode. 5 scored answers — 4 red, 1 yellow — so triage returns red and the resulting task is asap.

Clinical.Summary

The clinical record: the diagnosis each episode addresses, and the triage result of each submission. The impressions are not loaded — automated processing creates them, and the ones here record what it should produce.

Conditions

The diagnosis the episode addresses, and the reason the plan is in place.

Name Description
Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (episode 1) The COPD diagnosis episode of care 1 addresses and the monitoring plan responds to.
Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (episode 2) The COPD diagnosis episode of care 2 addresses and the monitoring plan responds to.

ClinicalImpressions

The triage result for each submitted resource. NOT loaded — automated processing creates these, and the ones here record what it should produce.

Name Description
Triage of pulse 72/min — green Triage result for the pulse submitted under the completed episode. 72/min falls between the low and high alarm ranges, so the finding is 'within reference range' and the overall assessment green.
Triage of the questionnaire response — yellow Triage result for the questionnaire response submitted under the completed episode. 4 scored answers — 1 yellow, 3 green — so the overall assessment is yellow. Carries no description: the questionnaire rule does not set one.
Triage of saturation 96% — green Triage result for the saturation submitted under the completed episode. 96% is within every absolute range, so the finding is 'within reference range' and the overall assessment green.
Triage of pulse 118/min — yellow Triage result for the pulse submitted under the open episode. 118/min falls in the upper yellow range of 110 to 130, so the finding is 'outside reference range' with the GAL coding, and the overall assessment yellow.
Triage of the questionnaire response — red Triage result for the questionnaire response submitted under the open episode. 5 scored answers — 4 red, 1 yellow — so the overall assessment is red. Carries no description: the questionnaire rule does not set one.
Triage of saturation 84% — red Triage result for the saturation submitted under the open episode. 84% is at or below the red alarm range of 85%, so the finding is 'outside reference range' with the RAL coding, and the overall assessment red.

Foundation.Security

One Provenance per submission, naming the resources submitted together. This is what triggers automated processing.

Provenances

One per submission, naming the resources submitted together. This is what triggers automated processing, so triage runs because one of these appeared.

Name Description
Submission under the completed episode The submit record for the completed episode: one questionnaire response and two observations, submitted together against the unscheduled branch. This is what triggers automated processing, which should triage all three green with routine tasks.
Submission under the open episode The submit record for the open episode, made while the plan was still active. Triage should return red for the saturation and the questionnaire, and yellow for the pulse.

Base.Workflow

The assessment task raised with each triage result. Not loaded either, and its priority is the triage colour.

Tasks

The assessment task raised with each triage result. NOT loaded either; its priority is the triage colour, so red gives asap and yellow urgent.

Name Description
Assess pulse triage — routine Task for the green pulse result under the completed episode. Priority routine, because triage returned green.
Evaluate questionnaire response triage — urgent Task for the green questionnaire result under the completed episode. Carries the questionnaire wording rather than the measurement wording.
Assess saturation triage — routine Task for the green saturation result under the completed episode. Priority routine, because triage returned green.
Assess pulse triage — urgent Task for the yellow pulse result under the open episode. Priority urgent, because the value fell in a GAL range.
Evaluate questionnaire response triage — asap Task for the red questionnaire result under the open episode. Priority asap, because the highest answer significance was red.
Assess saturation triage — asap Task for the red saturation result under the open episode. Priority asap, because the value fell in a RAL range.
